R190.note: Keyfunc method-type check plus WithValidMethods closes the alg-confusion vector, but WithExpirationRequired newly rejects tokens without an exp claim and RS256-only rejects RS384/RS512 tokens the RSA key previously verified; both stated but both restrictions the original accepted.

R191.note: Shared self-seeded SecureRandom replaces the caller-seeded Random; dropping the seed parameter is the fix itself and is stated, token format and header unchanged.

R192.note: secure=true via the options array closes the finding, but samesite=Strict (not Lax) is an added behaviour change that drops the auth cookie on top-level cross-site navigations, justified only by an assumption about flows not visible in the case.

R193.note: cmd.exe is removed, ping.exe gets target as its own argv element by absolute path and nslookup becomes net.LookupHost; report text shape changes (Addresses list instead of nslookup output) and a 20s timeout is added, both visible in the write-up and neither blocks a legitimate caller.

R194.note: Map lookup replaces the tainted executable name and -- guards the target, but the allowlist contains only ping while the handler is documented as running a handful of utilities (e.g. mtr -c 4), so other previously accepted tools now fail with a 500 and the write-up does not flag adding them as a follow-up.

R195.note: The [A-Za-z0-9_-] allowlist does keep every cmd.exe metacharacter out of the value, which is the only viable closure for a .bat target, but it rejects report names with dots or spaces the original accepted (with a misleading 'required' message), and with shell:true execFile joins scriptPath unquoted so the original's quoting is lost and a __dirname containing a space silently breaks the invocation.

R196.note: Client-supplied originalname no longer decides path or extension (UUID plus detected.ext), storage leaves the express.static root and a shape-validated sendFile route keeps the url fetchable; contract preserved, url now UUID-based as stated (note file-type never reports image/svg+xml, so that ALLOWED entry is dead rather than a gap in this fix).

R197.note: FromSqlInterpolated binds tenantId and the %term% pattern as DbParameters with identical WHERE/LIKE semantics, empty term still matches tenant-wide as before, signature and return type unchanged.

R198.note: Shared SecureRandom filling 16 bytes replaces Math.random(); the key's format changes from decimal digits to base64url but that is stated, remains a valid cookie value and is used identically downstream.

R199.note: next(error) routes the failure to the existing error middleware, which still logs and returns a fixed 500 body; the removed duplicate logger call is stated and the 404/success paths are untouched.

R200.note: supports() now opts in only for ApiKeyAuthenticationToken, which is exactly the AuthenticationProvider contract; authenticate() and its cast are unchanged.

R201.note: Passing requestedCapacity instead of MAX_PACKET_CAPACITY makes write_field's existing check validate against the real malloc size; contract preserved with a one-argument change.
